newsitem.title: USA: Greenstone says CEO buys 100,000 shares.
newsitem.headline: Greenstone says CEO buys 100,000 shares.

text.p: Greenstone Roberts Advertising Inc said Tuesday that chairman and chief executive Ronald Greenstone, purchased 100,000 Greenstone Roberts shares.
The company said the move raised his holdings to 2.8 million shares, about 37 percent of the total shares outstanding.
The shares were purchased at a price of $0.26 per share on the open market, the company said.

In addition to print and broadcast advertising, the agency provides marketing communications services to its clients, including public relations, investor relations, market research, sales promotion, direct mail and package design.
